Pune, Maharashtra
Accountant skilled in finance operations, compliance and reporting. Notice period: 60 days.

Accountant, Bluefin Logistics — Sep 2024 - Aug 2026
Managed monthly bookkeeping and reconciliations for freight and warehousing accounts using Tally; streamlined vendor payment cycles and reduced reconciling items by 32%. Prepared GST returns and maintained GST compliance across states, resolving mismatches that recovered INR 1.2M in input credits. Coordinated TDS calculations and timely deposit filings for vendor and contractor payments, implementing a checklist that improved on-time TDS filings to 100%.

Accountant, Accenture — Aug 2023 - Aug 2024
Prepared financial schedules and supported budgeting with Financial Modeling for project cost tracking, contributing to a 10% reduction in project variance. Handled TDS computations and documentation for consulting engagements, ensuring accurate withholding and reporting. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align reporting with IFRS principles and maintained records in Confluence for audit readiness.

Skills: Tally, GST, TDS, IFRS, Financial Modeling, Confluence

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
